import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix label variants in 'island' column
    df = df.copy()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    
    # Fix label variants in 'sex' column
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    # Remove negative flipper_length_mm values (invalid)
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Remove body_mass_g values out of valid range (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
